page-structure.evidence: Heading hierarchy is broken in two ways. (1) The shopping-bag sidebar renders an H2 ('Your shopping bag is empty.') before the product H1 ('Jacket with Collar'), producing an inverted H2→H1 sequence. (2) After the product H2 ('Color:'), delivery headings jump directly to H4 ('Shipping', 'Free pick up at') skipping H3, confirmed by axe heading-order violation. Title 'Men’s Dark beige Jacket with Collar | H&M US' is descriptive (passes 2.4.2). Landmarks present: header, nav (Primary navigation), main, footer, regions with aria-labelledby. One axe 'region' violation: the skip-to-content link is outside all landmark containers. listStyleNone=6 → VoiceOver list-semantics strip risk (Chrome AX still reports lists). Missing h1 before h2 is a structural violation (1.3.1), not just best-practice.

grouping-and-reading-order.evidence: 6 ul/ol lists have list-style:none without role='list', creating VoiceOver list-semantics strip risk (1.3.1). The aria-roledescription='carousel' axe violation (serious, 4.1.2): three product recommendation carousels use role='presentation' + aria-roledescription='carousel', which is invalid (aria-roledescription requires a semantic role). Tab walk shows reading order is broadly logical (top→bottom). Breadcrumb nav (tab stops 40-44) appears after product content in DOM order, which matches visual flow.

Cannot fully confirm without a reliable focus screenshot. Reason: element at x=-1,y=-1 is off-screen.
